agent_behavior_modifiers.bolt: REAL Lighthouse baseline captured 2026-07-26: Performance 98/100 (FCP 0.8s, LCP 0.8s, TBT 0ms, CLS 0) — this is already excellent, so remaining work is incremental, not urgent. Two real, measured targets for the next cycle: (1) 'Reduce unused JavaScript' — 47.6 KiB of 108.9 KiB in index-CbnyoU4-.js is unused on the homepage; investigate code-splitting/lazy-loading. (2) Lighthouse's Network dependency tree confirms the font-loading chain adds ~2,143ms to critical path (validates PR #24's premise) BUT also flags 'Unused preconnect' on the Formspree origin specifically — the preconnect from PR #24 is opening a connection most page loads never use; consider downgrading it to dns-prefetch (cheaper, no early TLS handshake) or removing it. The earlier suspected cold-start issue remains closed (see known_issues) — do not re-open without new evidence.
agent_behavior_modifiers.palette: the audit request form and contact form (already consolidated into one shared component as of 2026-07-24) are the highest-priority surface — they're literally the lead-gen mechanism for the whole business. REAL FINDING (Lighthouse, 2026-07-26): text-[#666] on #0c0c0c background fails WCAG contrast — affects labels like 'THE PROBLEM', 'THE SERVICE', and other eyebrow/muted text across the site. The design_system block does not currently define an official compliant secondary-text color, so do not silently pick one — flag it for the founder to approve a specific replacement (e.g. a lighter gray around #999, which typically clears AA on near-black) and add it to design_system as the official token before applying it site-wide. HARD CONSTRAINT otherwise unchanged: never introduce a new color, a rounded card, or a font outside the approved set. The pricing page's clarity across the three tiers (Maintain/Growth/Compound) is second priority.
agent_behavior_modifiers.sentinel: this codebase already had one CRITICAL code-injection vulnerability in the chart/health-widget rendering component — treat any component that renders dynamic Health Score, evidence, or benchmark data client-side as higher scrutiny than average. HSTS/CSP headers are already deployed (2026-07-17) — verify future changes don't loosen them. TypeScript strict mode is on, which removes a class of bugs by default — flag any new `any` or `@ts-ignore` as a regression worth fixing, not tolerating. shadcn/ui components are vendored (copied into the repo), not npm dependencies — audit them like first-party code, not like a third-party package.
agent_behavior_modifiers.fin: static/serverless hosting on Vercel — cloud cost surface is small. Don't force a monthly Fin cycle if there's nothing meaningful to find; a 'no savings opportunities' report is the honest and expected output here for now.
agent_behavior_modifiers.general: this site is the founder's own proof-of-product — every merged PR here is potential sales evidence for the /evidence page, so Evidence Blocks should be held to the same rigor SES promises its own future clients. Zero test coverage currently, so keep every PR small. Package manager is Bun — every verify/test/lint/build command any agent runs should use `bun`, not npm/pnpm/yarn.
